criteria.text: Run one reproducible production-safe benchmark round with two repetitions per case and freshly rerun all baselines. Core sales candidates: z-ai/glm-5, z-ai/glm-5.2, deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash, and deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro. Fast/system candidates: nex-agi/nex-n2-mini, z-ai/glm-5.2, deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash, and deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro. Use the accepted 12 sales and 24 system synthetic cases, identical route settings, sequential calls, blind sales review before unblinding, structured JSON/schema and semantic gates, latency and reliability evidence, and preserve raw artifacts. Select a route recommendation only after hard correctness gates; document practical rankings even when no candidate passes every release gate. Do not change production routing or use customer data.
